requirements.description: Microsoft FY2025 10-K: original text identifying the three reportable segments (Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, More Personal Computing) and, for each, the source's definition of its principal products/services/activities (the 'primarily comprises' enumeration), with segment affiliation and necessary qualifiers. Business composition only; not a full product catalog or revenue numbers.
